The '''Feldwes system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] sector in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It sat on the [[Ardan Cross]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]], and was the location of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Feldwes]], the industrial powerhouse of the [[Back Reach]].<ref name="TEA" />
